_comment: THE defaults for build_visibility_mask.py and build_smoketest_dev_split.py -- the scripts hardcode none of these. Edit this file and run with NO flags. A CLI flag is optional and overrides the matching key for that one run only. Relative paths are resolved against the qcar_testbed_integration/ root. smoketest_* keys belong to build_smoketest_dev_split.py (it refuses to overwrite an existing destination).
